title: 被動、比較與特殊句型
subtitle: Passive, Comparison & Special Structures
summary: 被動語態是商務英文的日常，比較級與倒裝則是拉開分數的地方。這一章把三個高頻結構一次講透。

sections.title: 被動語態的形成與時態

blocks.value: 被動語態 = be + 過去分詞。時態變化全部發生在 be 動詞上，過去分詞不變。
商務英文偏好被動的三種情況：不知道或不必說誰做的、要強調動作對象、要讓語氣客觀不指責。

items.en: The invoice was sent to the wrong address.
All equipment must be inspected before use.
items.zh: 所有設備使用前必須檢查。

blocks.value: 不及物動詞沒有被動：happen, occur, arrive, rise, appear, consist, belong。The accident was happened.（錯）

blocks.q: The revised guidelines _____ to all departments last Monday.
blocks.explain: guidelines 是被分發的對象，且有明確過去時間 last Monday，用過去被動 were distributed。

blocks.value: 授與動詞有兩種被動；使役與感官動詞被動時要還原 to。

items.en: The client was offered a discount.
A discount was offered to the client.
The staff were made to attend the workshop.
items.zh: 員工被要求出席工作坊。

blocks.value: It is said that… 句型可改寫成 S + be said to V。

items.en: It is believed that the merger will close in June.
items.zh: 一般認為併購將在六月完成。

items.en: The merger is believed to close in June.

blocks.value: by + 執行者 只有在真正需要強調時才寫出來。多益閱讀裡大多數被動句根本不寫 by。
兩者相比用比較級 + than；三者以上用最高級 + the，範圍用 in / of。

items.en: This supplier is more reliable than the previous one.
items.zh: 這家供應商比前一家可靠。

items.en: She is the most experienced engineer on the team.
items.zh: 她是團隊中經驗最豐富的工程師。

rows: as efficient as the old model
the + 比較級, the + 比較級
比較級 + and + 比較級
one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞

blocks.value: 比較的對象必須對等：Our revenue is higher than our competitor.（錯，拿營收比公司）→ than that of our competitor / than our competitor's.

blocks.q: The updated model consumes _____ energy than its predecessor.
blocks.explain: energy 是不可數名詞，比較級用 less。fewer 用於可數複數。

blocks.value: 否定或限制性副詞放句首時，主要子句必須倒裝：助動詞（或 be / do）移到主詞前面。

items: 否定副詞：Never, Rarely, Seldom, Hardly, Scarcely, Little, Nowhere
限制：Not only…but also, Not until…, No sooner…than, Only after / Only when / Only if
其他：So + adj. + that…, Such + N + that…

items.en: Rarely does the committee reject a proposal.
Not until the audit was complete did we release the funds.
items.zh: 直到稽核完成我們才撥款。

items.en: Only after receiving approval can you proceed.
items.zh: 只有在取得核准後你才能繼續。

items.en: So rapidly did demand grow that we expanded the plant.
items.zh: 需求成長之快，讓我們擴建了廠房。

blocks.value: Only after / Only when 之後的子句不倒裝，倒裝的是主要子句。這是最容易做錯的地方。

blocks.q: Not only _____ the deadline, but the team also reduced costs.
blocks.explain: Not only 置於句首，主要子句要倒裝成 did they meet。

blocks.value: 分裂句（cleft sentence）用來強調句中的某個成分。

rows: It is/was + 被強調部分 + that/who…
It was the supplier who caused the delay.
What we need is a clearer timeline.

blocks.value: 為避免重複，英文常省略重複的成分，或用 do / so / not 替代。

items.en: The proposal was approved, and the budget was too.
Will the shipment arrive today? I hope so.
items.zh: 貨今天會到嗎？希望如此。

items.en: Some team members attended; others did not.
items.zh: 有些成員出席了，其他人沒有。

blocks.q: _____ impressed the client most was the team's responsiveness.
blocks.explain: What 引導名詞子句當主詞，等於 The thing that…。
